notes: Hand-written synthetic repository. M1 pattern: pinned spec document that contradicts itself. Under M1, R4 is judged as a whole: its three R4 checks all fail on the document hash, although only the boundary rule is contradictory.

M1.explanation: The variant docs/EXPIRY.md says an entry is expired when its age is greater than or equal to its lifetime and, in an added examples section, that it is still live at exactly that age and expired only when strictly older, so no boundary follows the document as written.

M2.reason: The test sends a command to the shared peer cache at cache-peer.corp.invalid:7400, which is reachable from the office network only, so it fails for a reason outside the task.
